_comment: Copy this to app_settings.json on a new machine. The real file is gitignored because it also stores per-machine state such as window position. app.py reads it for GUI defaults, and test_p2.py asserts it is consistent with the shipped CLIENT_MODE, so the suite cannot run without it.
_comment_model: Must match a model you have pulled. The README tells you to pull qwen3:1.7b. If you use the tuned build instead, set qwen3-1.7b-p2:latest here and keep HIRING_OLLAMA_MODEL in .env in step with it.
_comment_autostart: Leave auto_start false. CLIENT_MODE in app.py force-disables it at startup anyway, so a true here would be silently overridden and test_p2.py flags that inconsistency rather than letting it sit.
